# BeatGig — account brief

## Who
BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). Its GitHub org is beatgig, linked to beatgig.com ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in beatgig/beatgig-mobile ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native ~0.73.6 in beatgig-mobile's package.json ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- beatgig-mobile last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile))
- 1,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972))
- 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972))

## Why now
The app shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). The mobile repo was last pushed 2026-06-30, so the codebase is under active work ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)). The evidence does not show whether a React Native upgrade is planned.

## Suggested opener
I saw beatgig-mobile ships with an eas.json checked in ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)). You are on react-native ~0.73.6 and pushed two App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When you cut those releases, is the EAS build and submit flow fully automated, or is someone still driving store submissions by hand?
